newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major warns taxes would rise under Labour.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major warns taxes would rise under Labour.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major predicted on Tuesday that more than half a million Britons could lose their jobs if the main opposition Labour party won Thursday's election.
Giving his penultimate morning news conference of the campaign, Major also warned that taxes, both local and national, would rise, as would the price of home mortgages, under a Labour government.

"Over half a million people could lose their job because if Labour follow policies like those in Europe and sign up to the Social Chapter and minimum wage, the extra costs on business mean we would get Europe's unemployment too," Major said.
He said a vote for Labour, which has scheduled an emergency budget for July, was a "one-way bet" for higher taxes and rising inflation.
